title: GAMMA: zero of 79 positive rows exact, and the landed GAMMALN kernel did not touch it
status_plain: A fresh 156-row live sweep re-scoped this row: on the positive side OxFunc matched Excel on none of 79 rows, with errors to 1,370 ULP, and the negative side reaches 810,000 ULP. This is current. The GAMMALN kernel landed in 2026-07-18 is wired only to the two GAMMALN surfaces -- the code says so in as many words -- so it did not change GAMMA, and GAMMA remains future work in the catalogue's own forward plan.
